# eon_restore_aws_subnets (Data Source)

Lists AWS subnets and their VPCs in a restore account and region.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "eon_restore_aws_subnets" "example" {
  restore_account_id = "restore-account-id"
  region             = "us-east-1"
}

output "restore_aws_subnets" {
  value = data.eon_restore_aws_subnets.example.subnets
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `region` (String) AWS region to list subnets in.
- `restore_account_id` (String) Eon restore account ID.

### Read-Only

- `subnets` (Attributes List) Subnets available in the region. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subnets))

<a id="nestedatt--subnets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `subnets`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) AWS subnet ID.
- `vpc` (String) AWS VPC ID containing the subnet.
